sample.rule: primary: rows 0-1099 + valid labels; sensitivity: policy-dependent

models_aggregation.definition: Each metric is computed on one outer validation fold; *_mean / *_std are taken over all outer folds (n_splits x n_repeats), std with ddof=1. Fold std describes fold-to-fold score variation on this fixed dataset.
models_aggregation.confusion_matrix_sum: Sum of per-fold confusion matrices over all folds of all repeats; each included sample is counted once per repeat (n_repeats times in total), so the total is not a count of independent samples.

dummy.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over all outer folds; each sample counted once per repeat

lr_all.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over all outer folds; each sample counted once per repeat

lr_no_psych.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over all outer folds; each sample counted once per repeat

nested_single.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over all outer folds; each sample counted once per repeat

rf_all.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over all outer folds; each sample counted once per repeat

svm_all.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over all outer folds; each sample counted once per repeat

models_repeat_aggregation.definition: For each repeat, predictions from all outer validation folds are merged by source_row_id into one complete out-of-fold (OOF) vector covering every included sample exactly once; metrics (including macro-F1) are recomputed from that pooled vector. *.mean / *.std are taken over repeats, std with ddof=1.
models_repeat_aggregation.interpretation: Repeat std describes variation due to the random partition on the same fixed dataset. Repeats reuse the same data and are not independent samples of new datasets; neither repeat std nor fold std is a confidence interval for external generalization.
models_repeat_aggregation.confusion_matrix_sum_over_repeats: Sum of per-repeat OOF confusion matrices; each included sample is counted n_repeats times, so the total is not a count of independent samples.

dummy.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over 10 repeats; each sample counted 10 times

lr_all.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over 10 repeats; each sample counted 10 times

rf_all.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over 10 repeats; each sample counted 10 times

svm_all.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over 10 repeats; each sample counted 10 times

lr_no_psych.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over 10 repeats; each sample counted 10 times

nested_single.confusion_matrix_sum_unit: sum over 10 repeats; each sample counted 10 times

persistent_errors.definition: error rate >= 0.8 over repeats in each of lr_all, rf_all, svm_all, nested_single
